title: HIRAKU contract
description: Shapes shared by every part of HIRAKU: the requirements file, the design, load cases, predictions, analyses, comparisons, causes, verdicts, judgements, tools, the project file and the events.jsonl line. Validate with hiraku.contract.validate(kind, obj), where kind is a key of $defs.

unit.description: Unit strings. A comparison is only made between equal unit strings; convert before comparing.

domain.description: Seven analysis domains plus assembly. Japanese names: handling 操安, powertrain 動力, aero 空力, crash 衝突, strength 強度信頼性, nvh 音振, thermal 熱, assembly 組み立て.

agent_id.description: lead = まとめ役, designer = 設計役, packager = パッケージ役, cae.<domain> = 分野ごとの CAE 役, system = HIRAKU itself (hooks, store), user = the person.

base.description: Solver base. K0 hand calculation, K1 3D beam FE, K2 3D vehicle physics, K3 power and thermal circuit, K4 geometry, interference and people, K5 contribution and sensitivity.

test_id.description: Catalog test id, e.g. S1, P1, R1, R4.

flags.description: Product property flags (catalog section 1). ride 乗, lean 預, self_propelled 走, outdoor 外, rough 悪, public_road 公, battery 池, electric 電, pinch 挟, cargo 荷, standing 置, near_people 近, liquid 液, vibration 振, continuous 続, assembly 組, preload 張, sound 音, handheld 持. The speed range 速 is speed_class.

speed_class.description: 速: static 静, walk 歩 (<= 2 m/s), vehicle 車 (<= 40 km/h).

basis.description: Where the value comes from (citation or 'assumption').

requirements_file.description: Input file given to HIRAKU (YAML or JSON). In the MVP the design is fixed and named by design_file.

want.description: What the person wants to make, in their words.

tests.description: Optional: run only these tests. When absent, tests are chosen from the catalog by flags.

design_file.description: Optional: path (relative to the repository) of a fixed design JSON.

dims_mm.description: e.g. rect_tube: {b, h, t}; round_tube: {d, t}.

verified.description: false until the value is checked against the cited source.

support.description: Something that touches the ground: a wheel, caster or leg. K2 builds the vehicle from this list.

kc_table.description: Path of a K&C table file.

frame_node.description: Frame node that carries this support's load into the frame.

kind.description: frame, suspension, wheel, battery, motor, controller, seat, occupant, cargo, body, rollbar, ... Occupants and cargo are parts (kind occupant / cargo); a load case chooses which are on board with params.loading.

rpy_deg.description: Roll, pitch, yaw of the box.

carried_by.description: Frame nodes that carry this part's weight (split equally unless the solver says otherwise).

part.description: Part id this member belongs to.

design.description: One design version. Coordinates in mm, ISO 8855 axes (x forward, y left, z up), origin on the ground below the middle of the front axle, so everything behind the front axle has negative x (the rear axle is at x = -wheelbase). Versions are never rewritten; a change makes a new version.

variables.description: Named design variables, e.g. wheelbase, track, cg_height.

criterion.description: Pass condition of a load case. The limit is computed by code from requirements (and materials) when the load case is built.

basis.description: How the limit was made, e.g. 'yield 235 MPa / Q61 1.5'.

params.description: Test conditions. params.loading (string) chooses who and what is on board: empty, driver, two, two_cargo (catalog Q30). Without it, solvers use two_cargo.

tolerance_rel.description: Allowed |analyzed - predicted| / |predicted| for a match. Set by code from the catalog or tool spec, never by the model.

feeds.description: Load cases that take this case's results as input (e.g. P1 wheel force feeds R1).

formula.description: A K0 hand-calculation formula as listed on the tool shelf.

term.description: One term of a formula or one effect, used for contribution and explanation.

share.description: Fraction of the total, or elasticity for sensitivities.

prediction.description: A hand-calculated prediction. The value is computed by K0 from formula_id and inputs, never typed by the model.

quantity.description: Name of the predicted quantity, e.g. front_wheel_force, max_stress.

tool_check.description: One known-answer case a tool must reproduce before it is usable.

source.description: Where the expected value comes from (closed form, textbook, ...).

tool_spec.description: An analysis tool on the shelf (A4). A tool with usable=false must not be run.

formulas.description: K0 formula ids that predict this tool's quantities.

where.description: Member, node, support or part id where the value occurs.

field.description: A field to draw as a contour or mode shape.

vector.description: An arrow to draw: a reaction, grip force or applied load.

analysis.description: One analysis run (RUN in the ER diagram). It cannot exist without at least one prediction.

inputs_from.description: Analysis or prediction ids whose values were used as inputs (e.g. the wheel force passed from P1 to R1).

comparison.description: Prediction vs analysis. A mismatch blocks the domain until a cause is recorded.

diff_abs.description: analyzed - predicted, signed, in the unit of both.

diff_rel.description: (analyzed - predicted) / |predicted|, signed. status is match when |diff_rel| <= tolerance_rel.

safe_side.description: The CAE role judged that the comparison, though a mismatch, is seen from the safe side: the cause explains the gap and the unfavourable one of the two values bounds the true value. Then a verdict may be made from that value.

safe_side_reason.description: Why the unfavourable value bounds the true one (required when safe_side is true).

verdict.description: Pass or fail of one test. Made inside the tools only: from a matching comparison (compare), or from an explained safe-side mismatch (record_cause with safe_side true).

margin_pct.description: Positive when passing: how far the value is from the limit, as % of the limit.

basis.description: match: from a matching comparison (value = analysis). explained_safe_side: from a mismatch whose cause has safe_side true and whose numbers confirm it (value = the unfavourable of prediction and analysis). Absent means match.

judgement.description: Verdicts of one domain for one design version (one tile of A6).

prop.description: The pet's prop: binder, pencil, spanner, steering_wheel, battery, windsock, crash_target, i_beam, tuning_fork, thermometer.

project.description: runs/<run_id>/project.json. Written at the start of a run; status and requirements are updated in place, everything else is append-only elsewhere.

event_kind.description: Closed list. Ask the lead (統括部) to add a kind; do not invent one locally.

event.description: One line of runs/<run_id>/events.jsonl. The screen draws only from these lines (live and replay). For *.recorded / *.created / analysis.finished / judgement.updated / tool.checked, data is the full record, identical to the record file.

seq.description: 0, 1, 2, ... with no gaps within a run.

t.description: Seconds since run.started; replay timing uses this.

text.description: Speech bubble or log line, shown as is.

tool_input.record_prediction.description: Agent-facing MCP tool. K0 evaluates formula_id with inputs; the model never supplies the value.

output.description: Which formula output is the predicted quantity, when the formula has more than one.

tool_input.analyze.description: Agent-facing MCP tool. One entry point for every analysis tool, so tools made during a run (N13) are callable without re-registering MCP tools.

result_quantity.description: Which analysis result to compare, when its name differs from the prediction's quantity.

assembly_step.description: One step of the assembly order (A7).

direction.description: Direction the part moves in when it goes in, e.g. -x, +z.

depends_on.description: Parts that must already be in place.

blocked_by.description: When it cannot go in: what blocks it.

interference.description: Two things that overlap, at rest or somewhere in their motion.

condition.description: Where in the motion, e.g. 'steer 30 deg, bump 80 mm'.
